definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 'method: A procedural entity defined by a method definition within, or inherited by, a class definition'; 2023 describes the same entity in 9.3.4 instead of its definitions clause. GR5 makes USING operands formal parameters of a function, method or program; the same entities.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:9.3.5 binds a method by name only ("if a method with the method-name specified in the invocation is defined in the class of the object, that method is bound"); 2023 9.3.6 adds signature matching (overloading). Positional formals are the same whichever method is bound; l1c22_positional_formals_oo_func matches at --std 2002.
